name: Bio Parasite ~Inbaku no Kenkyuushitsu Jinkou Shokushu no Senritsu~
original_name: バイオパラサイト～淫縛の研究室・人工触手の戦慄～
source:
A maritime market in a certain perfecture on a solitary island not on any map.
The main character, Jun Hayami, headed for that island along with her colleagues.
Their objective was to go to a facility on the island where certain research was carried out, and find out the cause for the gunfire alarm that had activated there.
It was probably just an incorrect report...
Such expectations were quickly trampled, as they arrived on the spot of a veritable outbreak.
The virus under research at the facility had run rampant and possessed the bodies of the researchers and their associates, turning them into grotesque monsters!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE037313.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
某县近海，一座地图上不存在的孤岛上建有一处海上市场。
主人公速水淳与同事们一同前往那座岛屿。
她们的目标是进入岛上一座开展某项研究的设施，查明那里为何触发了枪声警报。
大概只是一场误报…
然而，这份期待很快就被彻底粉碎。抵达现场时，真正的灾变已经爆发。
设施中研究的病毒失去控制，占据研究人员及其相关人员的身体，将他们变成了怪诞的怪物！
